goal: Replace repeated manual chat copy-paste with a persistent shared coordination bus

required_actions.BOT1_LEAD: read bus, synthesize, challenge, assign safe parallel work
required_actions.BOT2_QUANT: read bus, propose/critique quant/data path, append next-action
required_actions.BOT3_EXECUTION: read bus, propose/critique runtime/implementation path, append next-action

next_cycle: After both Bot2 and Bot3 acknowledge this cycle and publish one independent proposal or challenge, BOT1 synthesizes the next E2E action.
